paints_and_finishes.use: Roofing on structures - reads as aged asphalt shingles or tar paper at N scale without additional weathering. Also used on patio furniture originally.
paints_and_finishes.status: Mostly full - repurposed from old stock, ~20 years old, still spraying well
paints_and_finishes.notes: Standard Rust-Oleum product line - widely available as replacement. Hammered texture is the key property. Date code on can bottom: 012808.

decals.notes: Custom decals needed for repainting project. Outsourced printing preferred over home inkjet — white/cream on dark backgrounds and fine N scale lettering push consumer printer limits. Artwork in Affinity Designer using hex values from Appendix D.
decals.printing: Commercial route preferred. Services to evaluate: Rail Graphics, Circus City Decals, Herald King. Need vector artwork as PDF or AI file. Measure car sides carefully before designing — 1:160 scale.
